# Odesa Branch of the Association of Obstetricians and Gynecologists of Ukraine

> The bilingual Ukrainian and English website of the Odesa Branch of the Association of Obstetricians and Gynecologists of Ukraine (OB AAGU). It shares association information, professional news, conferences, continuing professional development events, speaker profiles, and documents.

- [About the association — English](https://odessa-gyne-association.pages.dev/en/about-us/)
- [News — Ukrainian](https://odessa-gyne-association.pages.dev/news/)
- [News — English](https://odessa-gyne-association.pages.dev/en/news/)

- [Professional development events — English](https://odessa-gyne-association.pages.dev/en/bpr/)
- [Speakers — Ukrainian](https://odessa-gyne-association.pages.dev/speakers/)
- [Speakers — English](https://odessa-gyne-association.pages.dev/en/speakers/)
